The '''Commission Statistics and GIS''' ('''COSIT''') or the '''Commission Statistics and GIS''' ('''COS''', {{langx|ar|هيأة الاحصاء ونظم المعلومات الجغرافية}}) is the [[Government of Iraq]]'s statistics agency. It has its headquarters in Hay Al-Elwiya, [[Baghdad]].<ref>"[http://cosit.gov.iq/english/faq.php Frequently Asked Questions]." ({{Deprecated archive|url=https://archive.today/20130717204428/http://cosit.gov.iq/english/faq.php|title=Archive}}) Central Organization of Statistics. Retrieved on 17 July 2013. "Where is the location of COSIT in Baghdad? What is your address and telephone number? Iraq -Baghdad / Hay Al-Elwiya" - [http://cosit.gov.iq/faq.php Address in Arabic] ({{Deprecated archive|url=https://archive.today/20130717205305/http://cosit.gov.iq/faq.php|title=Archive}}): "أين يقع هيأة الاحصاء ونظم المعلومات الجغرافية  ؟ ما هو عنوانكم  ؟ العراق / بغداد / كرادة مريم بجانب جسر الجمهورية"</ref>
